notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6 is now available:

 Fixed various graphic issues regarding clothes noticeable when mix & matching different outfit pieces.
 Fixed collisions issues in specific apartment rooms.



-Mad Jackal Games

notes.notes:
Version 1.0.5 is now available:
Fixed bug which would cause returning to the main menu upon death to cause the save data to not be reloaded to its previous save state.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:

Fixed issue that would could incorrect or loss of items in the player inventory or soft lock game on load game.
